title: Hanasato Minori — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Minori's birthday
Rental Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And so...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, everyone! It's time to get started with Minori's birthday livestream!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<At last!>
<Oh, it's starting!>
<Minoriii!!! Happy birthdaaay!!!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you everyone! I'm so happy you're all tuning in to celebrate with me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And let's begin with a showstopper! Minori, do the honors!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Got it! Feast your eyes on this, guys! It's my birthday cake♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Ta-da!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, a cake!>
<A bird...with a big bill...?>
<Is that a shoebill?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that's correct!
It's a type of bird called a shoebill!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Airi bought it for me, and...
Come to think of it, where did you find this amazing cake?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, that's insider knowledge♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <But why a shoebill?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, funny story! The other day, we went to the zoo and—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll stop you right there!
It's time for a surprise!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Heh heh heh... Minori, I told you that you'd be telling us about your favorite animals for this part...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But actually, we planned a secret segment!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! A secret segment...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes! Get ready for...
“Minori Hanasato's Day Off: MORE MORE JUMP! Go to the Zoo”!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Y-You don't mean...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When we all went to the zoo the other day, we were secretly getting it all on video.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And now we'd like you all to appreciate the sight of Minori relaxing with her animal friends.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You guys were seriously doing that? I had no idea!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Minori on a day off?!>
<No but for real, I gotta see this!>
<MMJ at the zoo... Yes please...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, it looks like everyone's excited to watch. Well then, I'll press play!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When we want to take our time with a certain part, we'll say, “Stop!” Let us know in the comments if there are any parts you're curious about.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, this part is the Rainforest Area! This was when you—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Say, Minori... Why do you think this tiger won't stop staring at me?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, stop! Look at Airi! Her getting into a staring contest with that tiger was so cute!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That tiger gave me such an intense look. After a while, it started to feel like a competition to see who would look away first...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I lost. I have to hand it to that tiger, she was a determined one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Maybe she was drawn to someone as determined as you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<Oh no...
These chicks won't leave me alone...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, stop, stop!
Haruka getting pecked by all those chicks was so, so, so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Everyone, look closely!
See how the second chick from the right is...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna be here a while...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<Y-You can do it, Mr. Chipmunk...!
I'll be as still and tree-like as I can...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, stop here too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Again?! It hasn't even been ten seconds since the last time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But! That tiny chipmunk is trying to climb up to Shizuku's shoulder!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff... Huff...
I-I talked myself hoarse...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seriously... You didn't need to do all the heavy lifting like that.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Minori really stole the show today.>
<I've never seen Minori talk so much...>
<I get it though! They were all so cute!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe... I got to talk so much that I wrecked my throat... I have no regrets...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It sounds like you've got no more gas in the tank...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Geez... Well then, I'll take us home on Minori's behalf. Everyone, thank you all again for celebrating Minori's birthday with us!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I promise to keep doing my best... So please continue to support me...!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<She's totally lost her voice lol>
<Well done Minori!>
<Happy birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well then, until next time, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I-I'm so tired...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, well done, Minori.
It looks like the fans enjoyed how into it you were.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, I'm glad! Although you guys really surprised me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Actually, Minori...
We're not done surprising you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Remember how you were curious earlier? You wondered where I got this shoebill cake from.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I did...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The truth is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ta-daaa!
We made it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whaaat?! Saki?! Shiho?! Honami?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hiya there☆

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You guys too?!
Wait, so this cake...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yep! We all made it together!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Shii did the finishing touches by making the shoebill out of cookies and cream♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was surprised to get asked to do that out of the blue... But Honami, Saki and Momoi helped out, and we managed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? It's amazing that you guys made such a cute cake...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. But apparently, there's more than just cake.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's right. We brought you a present too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, it's this collage photo frame...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Photo frame? Whoa, it's got all these animals on it! That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ichika, Emu and I made it so you could have some way of displaying the photos you took at the zoo. We hope you like it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We made it so the shoebill and the penguin and all the other critters look like they're holding up the pictures!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you!
I'm so going to put this on display in my room!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, Operation: So Many Surprises was a success!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well then, we still have the shoebill cake, so how about we dig in?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Agreed! It's time for round two of Minori's birthday party!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hanasato!
Momoi and I decided on the flavor of your shoebill cake together. I was so pleased that it was to your liking.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I paid a lot of attention to detail when I was designing that Schubert cake. I wanted it to be true to life since me and you fed him together. Let's go visit him again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna join you!
It looked so fun when you were feeding him, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Minori!
We all worked really hard on that photo frame, so I'm glad you liked it. Let's take a group photo later!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kohane designed the photo frame, and Otori and I attached the animals. We put a lot of love into it, so we hope you get some use out of it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My favorite is the red panda on the top left! She's super cute, and she looks kinda like you, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy biiirthday, Minori♪
You talked so much on the stream! Getting to see my idol all lit up like that on her birthday was such a treat!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Akiyama badgered me into watching and kept saying, “I totally get it!” over and over... But, I guess that goes to show how talented an entertainer you are.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Your excitement was pretty infectious, Hanasato. I couldn't help but smile too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That stream was awesome! It was like you were sharing your happiness with us all! I hope you've had an amazing birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hanasato.
I watched your stream, and I felt like the way you interacted with all those animals really summed up who you are.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hanasato.
It can't be easy having to balance your career with studies, but I hope you keep up your idol work with Hinomori and the others.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hanasato.
I hope Robo-Dog and Samo can have a playdate sometime. I'd appreciate some data on large dogs.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Minori.
I found some lipstick that I think would look good on you, so I'll get Airi to pass it on to you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Minori.
I love that you bring so much energy into our lives. Please don't ever lose that wonderful part of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, agreed. Even when I'm feeling down, talking to you perks me right up! You're one adorable junior.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, I'm so happy we're in this group together. Let's keep giving it our all as members of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know I said it already, but happy birthday, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone! Thank you so much for always looking out for me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, a lot has been happening lately. We went on TV, we found our MORE MORE HOUSE... It feels like, step by step, I'm moving toward my dream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... And I owe it all to all of you who support me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm going to do more and more to keep delivering hope! So I hope you'll keep giving me your support!
